spots.notes: T$20 per person from Wikivoyage, matched by an Expedia listing 'pay 20 TOP cash per person when entering'. The operator's own pages give no price. Operator also sells tours (TT3 east coast, TT4 cultural tour) that bundle entry; those prices are not the entry fee. Site: cave ~400 m long with freshwater pools up to 8 m deep; beach 50 m from the entrance. Bio 'guided tours' is only partly supported: operator sells tours but a per-person entry is also taken.
Daily produce market per Wikivoyage ground floor, handicrafts upstairs. No entry fee found. No hours stored. Official site: none found (council market).

UNVERIFIED island day-access fee: none found. Boat from Nukuʻalofa about T$20 return (Wikivoyage; World Nomads says about US$20 with a meal); transport is not the price. No official site found for the island resort/restaurant; ticketUrl left null.

Colony in Kolovai village per Wikipedia; Tonga Tourism lists 'Flying Fox Reserve - Kolovai'. No fee found; operator site TT2 tour page says bats hang along the village road, so no gate. Coordinates null in placement: pin worker owns.
